sections.title: Spells
sections.note: Eight spells, one from the wise man in each town. The later ones want more magic bars.

items.name: Shield
items.howTo: Talk to the woman who steps out of her house in the town's second part; she lets you in to the old man.

items.name: Jump
items.howTo: Return the Trophy to the woman in Ruto.
items.reward: Jumps about twice as high and far

items.name: Life
items.howTo: Return the Mirror to the woman in Saria.
items.reward: Restores about three bars of life

items.name: Fairy
items.howTo: Bring the Water of Life to the old woman for her sick child.
items.reward: Link flies as a fairy, and through locked doors

items.name: Fire
items.howTo: Bring water from the fountain to the thirsty woman. StrategyWiki says the old man also wants 5 magic bars.

items.name: Reflect
items.howTo: Bring the Child home. StrategyWiki says the old man also wants 6 magic bars.

items.name: Spell
items.howTo: Enter the house in the town's second part (through the fireplace) with at least 7 magic bars.
items.reward: Turns most enemies into Bots, and raises the building with the Magic Key
items.notes: MP at Magic level 1 / 8: 120 / 16. StrategyWiki gives 98 MP at level 3; Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon give 96.

items.name: Thunder
items.howTo: The old man in the first ruined house teaches it once the magic meter is full (8 bars). The Cross shows the town's invisible Moas.
items.reward: Destroys every enemy on screen, and is the only way to hurt Thunderbird

sections.title: Sword Techniques
sections.note: Two knights teach a sword thrust; both need Jump to reach.

items.name: Downward Thrust
items.howTo: The church's main door is locked: use Jump to reach its upper door, where a knight teaches it.
items.reward: Jump, then press Down to stab below

items.name: Upward Thrust
items.howTo: From the low building in the town's second part, use Jump to go roof to roof, then crouch on the chimney to drop in; a knight teaches it.
items.reward: Jump, then press Up to stab above
items.notes: Jump Thrust on Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon's wiki.
